interpretation: Overall baseline versus candidate source/build changes, with native disabled on both sides.

coverage.buildMaps: retained bytes rehashed using declared known-root sources mapping and existing root/JSON normalization; mappings/names/sourcesContent/unknown sources preserved
coverage.hmr: reconstructed from retained report/log; every phase sourcemap rehashed from retained bytes
coverage.artifacts: complete recorded file sets compared exactly; full emitted JS bytes were not retained by collector
coverage.warnings: re-extracted saved CLI paragraphs; does not replace compiler diagnostic tests
coverage.identity: frozen fixture digests independently reconstructed; successful driver completion follows its post-run identity verification
coverage.compileCache: owned temporary directories, initial absence, environment and archive records verified; child CLI enableCompileCache API status not inferred
coverage.firstBuild: measured after prepare; does not prove completely cold CLI startup
